title: Connected digital environments
summary: Web and interface development across the connected Bjórr, Institution and learner-controlled study environments.

lensAssignments.rationale: The responsibility centres on implemented websites, responsive interfaces and connected digital environments.
The interfaces apply the related School and Institution visual registers across distinct public and learner-facing contexts.
lensAssignments.lensSummary: Brand and experience-system responsibility: applying the Bjórr identity registers across connected public and learner-facing digital environments.
